observations: Photo 0 shows the PS5 console box with the console partially visible inside, along with two controllers: one red and one white/black. The box has 'SONY' and 'PS5' branding clearly visible.
Photo 1 shows the top of the PS5 box, which is blue with 'SONY' and 'PS5' logos. The box appears to have some wear or damage at the top edge.

Photo 2 shows the two controllers placed on top of the closed PS5 box. The red controller has a white center, and the white/black controller is standard DualSense design. The box is white with 'PlayStation 5' text visible.
No photos show the console itself outside the box, nor any games, cables, or power supply.
The console is not shown powered on or in use.
The seller claims 'one month used, just as new' and '8 games installed inside', but no games or game discs are visible in any photo.

claims.claim: One month used, just as new
claims.evidence: No photos show the console itself, its condition, or signs of use. The box shows minor wear (photo 1), which may contradict 'just as new'.
No games, discs, or screenshots of the game library are shown. The console is not powered on to verify installed games.

risks.risk: Console may be damaged or have hidden defects (e.g., scratches, disc drive issues, software problems)
risks.proof: Photo of the console outside the box, showing all sides and condition, ideally with a close-up of the disc drive and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or non-functional, with lower value.

risks.risk: Games are not actually installed or are not legitimate (e.g., pirated, unlicensed, or not working)
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS5 home screen showing the 8 games installed, or photos of physical game discs with titles visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if no games are included, or games are not usable.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, manual, etc.)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Console is not genuine or is a counterfeit
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, and a photo of the console powered on with the PS5 boot screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially counterfeit, which drastically reduces value.
